get.description:
The OpenAI-compatible service used for insights. The API key is never returned:
only whether one is set and its last 4 characters.

put.description:
Saves base URL and model. `api_key` omitted keeps the stored key, a string
replaces it, `null` clears it.

post.description:
Sends one minimal chat request with the saved configuration; returns the latency.
409 `AI_NOT_CONFIGURED`, 502 `AI_PROVIDER_ERROR` / `AI_INVALID_RESPONSE`, 504
`AI_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT`.

schema.title: Response List Budget Accounts Api V1 Budget Accounts Get

get.description:
Budget in force per level-2 category for `month` (default: current month), for all
level-2 categories or one budget account's. Open to agent tokens.

put.description:
Sets amounts effective from a month; earlier months keep their version.
An `amount` of null clears that category's budget from the month on.

get.description:
The global two-level tree, or only one budget account's level-2 categories and
their level-1 parents. Open to agent tokens.

post.description: A level-2 category (with `parent_id`) needs `budget_account_id`; level 1 refuses it.

put.description:
Sets the display order of one sibling group (level 1, or one level-1 category's
children) and returns the whole tree. The ids must be exactly those of the group
(422 `CATEGORY_ORDER_MISMATCH`), so a level-2 category cannot change its parent here.

patch.description:
Partial update: name, and for level 2 description and budget account. Omitted
fields are kept. A new budget account of the same period takes the category's history
with it; one of the other period needs `budget_amount` (422 `BUDGET_RESET_REQUIRED`)
and replaces the history with that budget.

get.description: Payment channels; agents submit transactions per channel. Open to agent tokens.

schema.title: Response List Channels Api V1 Channels Get

post.description: All-or-nothing submission of one payment channel's transactions. Open to agent tokens.

409.description: BATCH_REJECTED: nothing written; details.items has one entry per item

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description:
The month's cached insight, and `stale` when its data changed since it was
generated. Never calls the model.

post.description:
Sends the month's summaries and transactions to the configured AI service and
stores the answer. A failure leaves the stored insight unchanged. 409
`AI_NOT_CONFIGURED`, 502 `AI_PROVIDER_ERROR` / `AI_INVALID_RESPONSE`, 504
`AI_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT`.

get.description:
Stored payments (never refunds) between two dates (inclusive, at most 366 days),
to find the payment a refund reverses. Open to agent tokens; the MCP `find_payments`
tool returns the same.
Recurring expenses the user expects, active ones first.

schema.title: Response List Schedules Api V1 Schedules Get

get.description:
The schedules due in `month`: paid (with the matching payment), pending or overdue;
and, for the current month, the forecast of the month's spending.
Payments of the last months that look recurring and no schedule covers yet.

get.description:
Year to date (January to the end of `month`) per annual budget account: annual
budget, actual, actual per month and per category. Every annual account, or one
(a monthly one is 422 `NOT_ANNUAL_ACCOUNT`).

Per month: total budget and total actual, for everything or one budget account.
Defaults to the 12 months ending at `to`. Budget and actual cover monthly budget
accounts only; annual accounts' spending is `annual_actual`.

Level-1 rows with nested level-2 rows: budget and actual, for monthly budget
accounts' categories. Annual accounts' spending of the month is `annual_actual`.
